Here is why those panels exist and why they currently display almost identical information:

---

### 1. Panel Comparison: What is Displaying Redundant Info?

The dashboard has two areas where information is duplicated:

#### A. Left Column ("Liturgical Context") vs. Right Panel ("Typikon Digest")
* **[Liturgical Context Card](file:///c:/Users/augus/OneDrive/Documents/Google%20Antigravity/Projects/Typikon%20Coded/cantor_dashboard/index.html#L143-L150)** (Left Column):
  * Displays visual badges and metadata: Feast Title, Dolnytsky Rank, Tone, Season, Vestment Color, Fasting Rule, Paradigm Number, and Service Types.
* **[Typikon Digest Panel](file:///c:/Users/augus/OneDrive/Documents/Google%20Antigravity/Projects/Typikon%20Coded/cantor_dashboard/index.html#L193-L200)** (Right Split Panel):
  * Generates the canonical rubric document. The top "General Info" section of the digest repeats the exact same Feast Title, Rank, Tone, Season, Vestments, Fasting Rule, and Paradigm Number.
* **Why this happened**: The Left Column was designed as a quick UI summary card, while the Typikon Digest was designed as a printable/copyable liturgical decree. When viewing both side-by-side, the metadata is shown twice.

#### B. "Typikon Digest" Tab vs. "Service Digest" Tab (inside the Reference Panel)
* **Typikon Digest Tab**: Renders the complete, unbroken Markdown rubrics for all services of the day.
* **Service Digest Tab**: Parses that **exact same digest** and filters it per service (Vespers, Matins, Liturgy) via a dropdown.
* **Why this happened**: The Service Digest tab was added as a convenience filter, but because it relies on the exact same underlying text, having both tabs open in the same panel creates unnecessary duplication.
